description: Defines a templated AVL Tree data structure with iterator support, including class declarations, methods for insertion, deletion, traversal, and utility functions.

classes.name: AVLTreeInOrderIterator
classes.description: Iterator for in-order traversal of AVL Tree, supporting increment, decrement, and dereference operations.

classes.name: AVLTree
classes.description: Templated AVL Tree class supporting insertion, deletion, search, traversal, and cloning.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereference operator returning the key of the current node.

methods.name: AVLTree
methods.description: Constructor for AVL Tree, with optional strict mode.

methods.name: isStrict
methods.description: Returns whether the tree is in strict mode.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of nodes in the tree.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a node with specified key and optional data.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a node by key or maximum.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts the tree into an array in ascending or descending order.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Searches for a node by key.

methods.name: Min
methods.description: Returns the minimum key and associated data.

methods.name: Max
methods.description: Returns the maximum key and associated data.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the beginning (smallest element).

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the end.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the beginning.
